item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates `dspy.ReAct(\"question -> answer\", tools=[get_weather])`, which is the minimal one-tool agent."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Reads `agent.react.signature.instructions` into `instructions` and prints it for inspection."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts both `get_weather` and `Get the weather for a city.` appear in `instructions`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `finish` appears in the generated instructions."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the JSON-format reminder string for `next_tool_args` appears in `instructions`."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Formats the signature as a system message and asserts `next_tool_name` is present."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
